# Carlton Davis Consulting

Carlton Davis Consulting helps business leaders and teams use AI in practical, responsible ways. The business provides AI workshops, team training, speaking, and strategy and advisory support. Based in Nashville, Tennessee, Carlton Davis serves organizations in Nashville and beyond.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.carltondavisconsulting.com/): Overview of Carlton Davis Consulting, AI training and workshops, speaking and events, AI strategy and advisory support, Carlton Davis's background, featured media, and contact options.
- [AI Workshops & Speaking](https://www.carltondavisconsulting.com/ai-workshops-speaking/): Details about workshops, speaking sessions, team training, session topics, audiences, and frequently asked questions.

## Services

- AI Training & Workshops: Hands-on, practical sessions that help leaders and teams build confidence using AI in everyday work.
- Speaking & Events: Keynotes, panels, and facilitated sessions for conferences, chambers, associations, boards, and leadership groups.
- AI Strategy & Advisory: Practical support for identifying where AI fits, improving workflows, and building responsible habits around new tools.

## Who it is for

Business owners, leadership teams, small and midsize companies, chambers and business associations, workforce and nonprofit partners, conferences, boards, and leadership groups.
